description: We are a team of 15-year-old high school students passionate about gaming and space, and we built Twelve Minutes Out to unite both. Rather than guessing, we grounded our entire simulation in real NASA data: JPL ephemeris orbital mechanics, Perseverance rover Jezero Crater weather telemetry, and official NASA-STD-3001 human life-support thresholds. It’s an authentic, high-stakes mission control experience powered by real-world spaceflight physics and science!
